sd.drafted: drafted until the line makes it solid
sd.line.chip: The whole die, drawn before anything is made: its pads, the units that compute and where the memory sits. Everything here is a plan.
sd.line.block: Your block inside the first unit, beside its registers and its control: your design's cells in the rows the placer put them in, and the wires between them.
sd.line.gate: Each cell as it will be printed: two strips of silicon, two gates across them, a rail for power above and one for ground below.
sd.line.switch: One cell, close: the gates you see here are where the line will make its switches.
sd.line.empty: Nothing is drawn on this die yet: your block waits for a design that does its job.
sd.line.broken: Your design does not do its job yet, so the line will not make it: its block is drawn red.
sd.line.switchOff: Your switch never turns off, so nothing above it can be made: its gates are drawn red.
